logfile.description: Path to log file. Blank or empty defaults to stderr.

log_format.description: Log format: default, plain (no timestamp), json.

log_level.description: Log level: panic, fatal, error, warn, info, debug, trace.

listen_plain.description: Listen addresses for incoming unencrypted connections.

local_cert.description: Path to the SSL certificate file.

local_key.description: Path to the SSL private key file.

local_forcetls.description: Enforce encrypted connection on STARTTLS ports before accepting mails from client.

strict_sender.description: Only use remotes where FROM EMail address in received EMail matches remote_sender.

max_connections.description: Max concurrent connections, use -1 to disable.

max_recipients.description: Max RCPT TO calls for each envelope.

allowed_nets.description: Networks allowed to send mails. Empty allows any.

allowed_sender.description: Regex for valid FROM addresses. Empty allows any.

allowed_recipients.description: Regex for valid TO addresses. Empty allows any.

remotes.description: Remote SMTP servers to relay mail to, space delimited.

command.description: External command to pipe messages to.
